description: Soot Puff default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/soot_puff-character-sheet.webp: the four palette chips (intake.json swatches 0,0,0 / 15,15,15 / 113,113,115 / 255,255,255) cross-checked against the drawn surfaces (sampler: service venv PIL, front view, body mask by edge distance, eyes masked out). Matte, dusty, no sheen, no glow (the sheet draws none).

body.note: base / crevices: chip 0,0,0 (x1300 y877); drawn front-view interior 8-15 px in from the edge median 2,2,2 (p10 0,0,0)

fuzz.note: fuzz crowns (puff crests): chip 15,15,15 (x1384 y877); drawn rim 0-3 px in from the edge median 17,17,17, FUZZY EDGE panel median 14,14,15

dust.note: dusty highlight on a few upper puff crowns: chip 113,113,115 (x1469 y877). The three views barely draw it (inside-body pixels > 60 lum: front 0, side 0, back 2; FUZZY EDGE panel crest highlights reach 66) -- the chip value is used, on a small seeded share of upper crowns (DUST_P)

face.note: eyes + mouth: chip 255,255,255 (x1554 y876); drawn eye / mouth blobs (lum > 128) are pure white
